subject: delta(client): WF let a paid purchase renew its seller session near the delegation end
note: sessionRenewal no longer applies the five-minute delegation safety margin to a paid purchase (status settled_verified). After a restart the renewal is how the seller hears of the payment, and the seller takes a request under a delegation that has not expired, so a paid purchase renews right up to the delegation's expiry and is refused with seller_delegation_expired once it has expired or its expiry is unknown. An unpaid purchase keeps the margin and its seller_delegation_expiring refusal. The margin constant and every other step that checks it are unchanged. The README lists the new refusal.
